Executive Threat Summary:
During the incident triage, security analysts identified activity targeting CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell). The adversaries connected from external IP 194.165.16.15 to pivot into internal host 192.168.1.100 (which is private and ignored). Secondary beaconing was observed communicating with hxxps://update-check[.]net/payload.bin and raw domain c2-telemetry[.]com.
Local forensic analysis examined suspicious files report.pdf and setup.exe.
